commit.message: fix: harden routing and runtime activity truth

interface_mismatches: The Claude Code native UI is interactive while the canonical provider factory is headless; the command must consume policy and runtime configuration directly, then exec only the resolved binary.

Persisted run status is an observation, not a lease. Current lease requires a matching execution identity, matching claim, acknowledgement, heartbeat, owner-policy-valid lease freshness, and absence of terminal, ambiguous, competing, or superseding evidence.

Generic orchestration and Mission Control own different expiry rules: Mission Control is bounded by stale_after, while GraphReconciler permits a fresh heartbeat inside the original lease duration after stale_after; the projection must label and apply the owning policy conservatively.

Acknowledgement and heartbeat timestamps are independent observations emitted by some atomic running transitions and cannot be ordered by microseconds; both must follow the claim and not be future-dated.
Any strictly newer claim permanently fences an older claim, while equal-timestamp competing maxima are ambiguous and must fail closed rather than produce multiple current leases.

Legacy payload keys named active remain for compatibility but their values become current-lease aliases; explicit observed_nonterminal and expired_or_unproven counts preserve the discarded uncertainty.
Topology active_agent and stored session status are owner-provided pointers, not process-liveness evidence, and remain separately labeled from lease-current agents and sessions.

The native interactive Claude model remains under explicit operator, resumed-session, or native CLI authority; an omitted model must route with no model hint and never inherit a headless provider default.

The fixed Claude Code CLI lane must remove metered Anthropic credentials and nested Claude session controls before resolution and process replacement while preserving unrelated operator environment settings.
honest_blockers: No generic read model can prove executor process liveness from persisted lease evidence; every new projection must carry proves_executor_liveness=false.

The effective Claude model and authentication substrate remain unknown before the native CLI starts; this packet proves the selected CLI transport, explicit-model consistency, and child-environment boundary only.
Legacy rows lacking an execution identity or complete lease evidence will intentionally move from active counts to expired_or_unproven without database mutation or deletion.
Credential revocation and provider-side rotation remain external operator actions and are not performed by this repository packet.
This packet does not restart terminals, Mission Control MCP servers, autonomous workers, or dashboards, and does not reconcile live runtime rows.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the implementation commit. This restores the previous projection behavior and direct chat launch code but does not re-enable the independently quarantined GitHub MCP or mutate any runtime database.
